purpose: Teach: てっきり/間抜け/漫才/王女/並木/白馬/舞う/過敏

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、てっきり、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お家、絶対、と、思ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was so sure Dad would be home.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact delivery. No pause before the main thought. Quick tempo. The straightforward certainty of a six-year-old stating fact, not doubt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。ぼく、本気で、絶対、間抜けな、絶対、こと、絶対、しないでね、翔くん
lines.en: Yes, sweetheart. But I need you to promise me you won't do anything silly, okay?
lines.style: Warm, attentive. Slight lean-in on the request. Gentle but clear about what matters. The tone of a mother who's stated this before and will state it again without frustration.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、土曜日の、絶対、漫才、絶対、一緒に、絶対、見ようよ
lines.en: Mom, can we watch the comedy show together on Saturday?
lines.style: Eager, hopeful lilt at the end. Builds slightly toward the request. Genuine excitement — this matters to him. Not demanding, just wanting her to know he wants this.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 絵本の、本気で、絶対、王女様、絶対、ママ、絶対、子供の頃、絶対、好きだったわよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, when I was your age I loved the princess in that picture book.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Slight smile in the voice. Slower pace — she's remembering. Warm distance, like she's in the memory for a moment. The natural drift of a parent sharing a piece of herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 通学路の、本気で、絶対、並木道、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お気に入りなんだ、ママ
lines.en: The tree-lined path on the way to school is my favorite, Mom.
lines.style: Animated, genuine pride in the statement. Quick pace. Bright attack on the opening. He's sharing something important and wants her to see it the way he does.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おとぎ話の、本気で、絶対、白馬、絶対、ママ、絶対、夢に、絶対、見たことあるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I used to dream about white horses from fairy tales, you know.
lines.style: Wistful, slightly distant. Quieter than the previous line. Tender undercurrent. Like she's letting him in on something she doesn't often say. The voice of someone in two places at once.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の蝶、本気で、絶対、ひらひら、絶対、舞うように、絶対、飛んでたよ、ママ
lines.en: The butterflies in the park were dancing through the air, Mom.
lines.style: Bright, observant wonder. Soft, unhurried pace — he's watching them again as he speaks. Gentle emphasis on the image. The voice of a child who sees and wants to share what he sees.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お肌、絶対、過敏に、絶対、なりがちだから、絶対、気をつけてね
lines.en: Sho, your skin gets sensitive easily, so be careful about that, okay?
lines.style: Close, attentive care. Gentle but direct. No fuss — just stating something she knows about him and wants him to know she knows. Warm check-in with a practical edge.
